description: This Java source file contains integration tests for advanced payment allocation and loan repayment scheduling in the Fineract platform. It includes multiple test cases (uc1 to uc13) that simulate various scenarios such as loan disbursement, payments, overpayments, refunds, delinquencies, and installment processing. The tests utilize REST API calls to interact with the platform and validate the correctness of repayment schedules, balances, and transaction states.
